refund.eligibility: Customers may request a change-of-mind return for unused, unopened products in their original packaging with the seal intact. Wrong, damaged or faulty products should be reported separately using the support contacts below.
refund.returnWindow: Customers may request a return within seven days of receiving their order. This ordinary return window does not remove applicable mandatory rights concerning wrong, damaged or faulty goods.
refund.damagedItems: If an item is wrong, arrives damaged or is faulty, contact support@sekkin.lk or WhatsApp 0740309918 with your order number, product details, reason and relevant photographs. Sekkin.lk covers the return delivery charge in these cases and evaluates these complaints separately from ordinary change-of-mind returns. Wait for return authorization and instructions before sending goods. Returned goods are inspected within two business days of receipt, and the outcome is communicated through your supplied contact channel. If a return is rejected, you will receive an explanation and may request further review through the same support contacts. Applicable mandatory consumer rights are preserved.
refund.condition: Products returned because of a change of mind must be unused, unopened and in their original packaging with the seal intact.
refund.requestProcedure: Submit return requests to support@sekkin.lk or WhatsApp 0740309918 with your order number, product details, reason and relevant photographs. Wait for return authorization and return instructions before sending products. The approved return destination is Mahawattha, Batapola, Sri Lanka; follow the specific instructions supplied for your authorized return. Returned products are inspected within two business days of receipt. The inspection outcome is sent through your supplied contact channel; a rejected return includes an explanation and a way to request further review through support.
refund.returnShipping: Customers pay applicable return delivery charges for ordinary change-of-mind returns. The courier return charge is LKR 500 for a parcel returned due to customer responsibility, including an incorrect delivery address, repeated unavailability after the three delivery attempts, refusal of a correctly supplied order or an ordinary change-of-mind return where that courier charge applies. This charge is disclosed before payment is required and is not charged twice for the same applicable returned parcel. A failed delivery attempt itself costs LKR 0. SEKKIN LK covers the applicable return delivery charge for wrong, damaged-on-arrival or faulty products. These rules do not restrict applicable mandatory consumer rights.
refund.refundMethod: Refunds are processed after the returned product is received, inspected and approved. Approved COD refunds are made by bank transfer, with the necessary transfer details arranged directly with the customer through support. The inspection outcome is communicated through your supplied contact channel. A rejected return includes a clear explanation and a way to request further review through support. Never send card numbers, expiry dates or security codes for a refund.
refund.refundTimeline: Approved refunds are processed within seven business days after the return inspection is completed and the refund is approved. Returned goods are inspected within two business days of receipt, and the inspection outcome is communicated through your supplied contact channel.
refund.cancellations: Customers may cancel before dispatch by emailing support@sekkin.lk, calling or sending a WhatsApp message to 0740309918 with their order number. Cancellation is confirmed when Sekkin.lk sends a cancellation confirmation to the customer. After dispatch, ordinary cancellation is unavailable; customers may request a return under this policy. Applicable mandatory consumer rights are not excluded.
refund.exchanges: Exchange requests may be made within seven days of receiving an order, subject to replacement stock. Ordinary exchange products must be unused, unopened and in their original sealed packaging. Approved exchanges are processed within two business days after the returned product is received and inspected, subject to stock availability. Customers pay exchange delivery charges unless Sekkin.lk sent the wrong item or the product arrived damaged or faulty. Any additional price difference must be settled before replacement dispatch. If the replacement costs less, the approved price difference is refunded by the bank-transfer method described in this policy.
refund.hygieneRestrictions: Opened bottles, broken seals and damage caused by the customer after delivery are excluded from ordinary change-of-mind returns. These hygiene/condition restrictions do not exclude remedies for wrong, damaged-on-arrival or faulty products, or override applicable mandatory consumer rights.
refund.consumerRights: The ordinary seven-day change-of-mind period, sealed-product conditions and customer-responsibility return charge do not remove applicable remedies for wrong, damaged, faulty or nonconforming goods. A remedy, including an appropriate replacement, refund or compensation where applicable, is assessed under the circumstances and applicable Sri Lankan law. You may seek assistance from the Consumer Affairs Authority or other competent authorities or courts without first completing the business's internal complaint process.

shipping.coverage: We deliver products islandwide across Sri Lanka.
shipping.processing: Orders are normally processed and dispatched within one business day after confirmation, subject to stock availability. Business days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and Sri Lankan public holidays.
shipping.deliveryEstimate: Delivery is estimated within 2–3 business days after order confirmation. Business days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and Sri Lankan public holidays. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed delivery date; courier delays and circumstances outside the business's reasonable control may affect delivery.
shipping.charges: A fixed delivery charge of LKR 350 applies to every order. The delivery charge is displayed at checkout before you confirm your order.
shipping.partners: Koombiyo Delivery Company is the delivery partner confirmed by the business owner. No courier API or automated tracking integration is claimed.
shipping.tracking: When the courier supplies a tracking reference, Sekkin.lk shares it manually through an available customer contact channel: WhatsApp, SMS or email. Tracking information is conditional on the courier providing it. My orders displays recorded order status, not live courier tracking; this website does not claim automated tracking, email or SMS integration.
shipping.delays: Sekkin.lk informs customers through their supplied contact channel when significant delivery delays become known. Customers may contact support@sekkin.lk or 0740309918 about a delayed delivery.
shipping.failedDelivery: The confirmed courier arrangement allows three delivery attempts. Customers must provide an accurate delivery address and reachable phone number. A failed delivery attempt itself has a LKR 0 charge. If delivery fails, SEKKIN LK contacts the customer to confirm details and arrange the next available delivery; if the parcel has returned to the business, the customer is contacted before another shipment is arranged. The customer pays the LKR 500 courier return charge when a parcel is returned due to customer responsibility: an incorrect address, repeated unavailability after the delivery attempts, refusal of a correctly supplied order or an ordinary change-of-mind return where the charge applies. SEKKIN LK covers the applicable return delivery charge for wrong, damaged or faulty goods; applicable mandatory consumer rights are preserved. The return charge is disclosed before requiring payment, applies only once to the same applicable returned parcel, and is separate from the normal LKR 350 per-order delivery charge. LKR 500 is not added to normal checkout or charged for an attempt alone. Any additional reshipment charge must be communicated and accepted before another shipment is arranged. Customer contact and courier handling are manual; no automated returned-parcel, fee collection or redelivery integration is claimed.

terms.liability: SEKKIN LK remains responsible for obligations and remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded. Delivery estimates are estimates and do not remove the duty to address unreasonable delay or an unfulfilled order. Nothing in these terms excludes liability or customer remedies where exclusion would be unlawful, including applicable rights concerning wrong, damaged, faulty or unsafe goods. No blanket exclusion, exclusive remedy, forced arbitration or waiver of access to competent authorities or courts is imposed.
terms.governingLaw: These terms and purchases are governed by applicable Sri Lankan law. Contact support first if you would like the business to try to resolve a concern, but the internal complaint process does not prevent you from contacting the Consumer Affairs Authority, another competent regulator or a court with lawful jurisdiction. No exclusive foreign forum, compulsory arbitration or restriction of applicable mandatory consumer rights is imposed.
terms.updates: These policies take effect on the actual public launch date of SEKKIN.LK. Their actual effective date and publication/last-updated date will be displayed on the relevant pages when published. Material changes will be communicated to affected customers where appropriate. No date is backdated or substituted with the earlier business-confirmation or wording-approval date.
